name: Chapter 1 Practice Test
_note: Built 2026-08-31. ASSEMBLED, not authored: the auto-graded slots are existing library questions already filed from the 1.1-1.5 pushes, attached by qsetid. The three FRQs are existing sources in questions/frq/descriptive-statistics/ that have never been filed - they need step 2 before the attach. Deliberately COMPARABLE to chapter-1-group-test.json (Steve 2026-08-31): slots 1-14 cover the SAME fourteen sub-topics in the same order, with DIFFERENT questions - zero qsetids are shared between the two. Slots 15-19 are the five extra sub-topics the practice test has room for. Points 19x4 + 3x8 = 100. Settings per reference/intro-stats-assessment-settings.md: 3 attempts x 20 versions, no penalty, 2% early-finish bonus at 24h, HW gradebook category (no Practice category exists in any course), up to 1 late pass, no time limit, no passcode. It opens on the 1.5 lab day and is due the day the chapter test opens, so its window spans the group test. Trimmed 2026-09-01 (Steve): hard 15 slots, 12 auto + 3 FRQ, 12x6 + 10 + 9 + 9 = 100. The two auto sub-topics cut were '1.1 classify the variable / key terms' and '1.2 name the sampling method' - both are still assessed, in more depth, by an FRQ on the group test (q2 classification-and-justification, q3 stratified-vs-SRS). The practice test drops the SAME two so the two tests stay slot-for-slot parallel, and also drops its five extra sub-topics (1.1 proportion key terms, 1.2 cluster vs stratified, 1.3 interval boundaries, 1.4 misleading display, 1.5 grouping differently) - those questions stay in the library, unattached. Both aids are ALREADY PUSHED at the old length: 23444241 and 23444240 need a re-sync (detach the cut qsetids, repoint the remaining points) before either is copied out. Repaired 2026-09-01 (Steve): slot 14 (qsetid 1893150) was filed with MOM qtype `essay` while its source is written in multipart form ($anstypes + $answerbox[0]), so it rendered with NO answer box at all - a 9-point question no student could answer. Flipped the library qtype to `multipart`; ONE library edit and master + P3 + P4 + P7 all picked it up, because an assessment points at a library question and all four share the qsetid. Slot 15 (qsetid 1893149) asked for the SHAPE of the distribution (skewed / symmetric), which is 2.6, not chapter 1 - rewritten in place to stay inside 1.3: relative frequency per class, cumulative relative frequency through the third class, and reading a percent off the table. Same qsetid, same 9 points, so again zero per-instance work and no student lost an attempt. Both FRQ rubrics also printed 4+3+3=10 on a 9-point slot; now 4+3+2=9. Slot 15's stem also dropped the school-class framing (Steve): the bins keep 'class width' / 'class boundaries', but the scores now come from 'the data set below' instead of 'students in an Introduction to Statistics class', so the word does not mean two things in one question. Slot 15 scope-corrected again 2026-09-02 (Steve): the rewrite still had students DERIVE the class width (range div 4, round up) and choose boundaries, and that is 2.2, not chapter 1 - every 1.3 question hands the student the table or the classes. The four classes are now printed in the stem and the student only tallies into them, so the whole question is 1.3 work: frequency, relative frequency, cumulative relative frequency through the third class, and a percent read off the table. Rubric reweighted 4+3+2 -> 3+4+2, still 9, because the arithmetic is now the graded work rather than the setup. One library edit on qsetid 1893149 again, so master + P3 + P4 + P7 all have it. STILL STALE and not fixed: the pre-FRQ that mirrors this task in HW 1.3 (questions/descriptive-stats/pre-frq-grade-a-frequency-distribution.php, qsetid 1874243) still grades responses on 'class width and boundaries' AND on naming the shape, so it now describes a task that no longer exists on either version of the FRQ.
